round: the narrowed round answering the review of 868cd58b (two findings; the architect's Narrow decision recorded on #2161)

proof.criterion: Finding 1 (charter path): no refusal counts an ask block an upload's stored version holds, so a third upload's new ask is reviewed, not passed by the breaker.
proof.surface: The real AskGate handler under pi-envoy's suite, with the fake Dispatch serving a stored brief.md holding #window (no live session can make the charter revise an upload twice in block mode on purpose).
proof.command: cd packages/pi-envoy && bun test extensions/askgate/askgate.test.ts -t "charter refusals|sent again unchanged"
proof.observed: 'an upload's charter refusals count only the asks the rules check judged, never a block its stored version holds, so a third upload with a new ask is reviewed' passes: three charter calls, three rules calls, no outcome="breaker". 'an upload sent again unchanged after two charter refusals goes out on the breaker, its judged new ask the thing refused' passes, so the breaker still ends an unchanged loop.
proof.negativeControl: With the charter path's count put back to `breakerThings(callAsks())`, the first test fails: the third upload's result is `<advisor-gate advisor="AskGate" outcome="breaker">` (the reviewer's reproduction).

proof.criterion: Finding 2: a decision record already in flight when shutdown begins is cut, and its entry is written before the shutdown handler returns.
proof.surface: The real AskGate handler under pi-envoy's suite, fake timers and an injected clock, a fake Dispatch record that answers only when aborted.
proof.command: cd packages/pi-envoy && bun test extensions/askgate/askgate.test.ts -t "at shutdown a" (run 3 times: 2 pass, 0 fail each)
proof.observed: 'at shutdown a decision record already in flight is cut short, so the gated call's entry is written before the handler returns': at return the entries are [{decision allow, outcome verdict, ruleOutcome none, recordError 'the session shut down before Dispatch answered the record'}], returned before 1,500 ms, record signal aborted. askgate-core.ts unchanged by this commit.
proof.negativeControl: With the shutdown `cut` callback made a no-op, the test fails with no entry at return (the reviewers' probe); the earlier post-shutdown test still passes in that state, which is why it did not cover this.

filesChanged: packages/pi-envoy/extensions/askgate/askgate-core.ts — refusalThings: one count rule for both refusal paths (f1f55963).
packages/pi-envoy/extensions/askgate/askgate.test.ts — the charter-path three-upload test, the unchanged-upload termination test (f1f55963), the in-flight shutdown record test (70bc570b).
trickyParts: Where nothing tells an upload's new asks from its stored blocks (rules check judged none, read partial, or no rules run), a charter refusal counts the call as a whole: an upload carrying asks never trips on that, so it is reviewed again rather than passed; `--advisor-rebuttal` still ends such a loop.
